banned_combo_check.note: Base is deep espresso #171310 with dark panels; no cream background anywhere. Serif display (DM Serif Display) is the ONE allowed trait. Buttons are sharp rectangles, not pills; hero is a full-screen photo with dark overlay, not a boxed card. Total 1 of 4, within limit.

colour_strategy: Dark base (deep espresso #171310, panels #221B15) + one bright accent (warm brass/gold #C9A227, light brass #E3C078 for text) + cream text #F5EDDD. No orange UI accents anywhere.
hero_type: Full-screen photo with dark overlay (loaves baking in the oven) + oversized display headline
honesty_notes: No invented reviews, ratings, prices, awards, staff names or numbers. No Google review count claimed (not verified). No hygiene claim anywhere (unverified snippet excluded). Friday hours use ThreeBestRated (7am-3pm); the conflicting 4pm claim is not stated. 'Prices on request' appears once, in the counter section. 'Why locals choose' is built from the five verified review themes, paraphrased, with no invented quotes. Gallery labelled illustrative of the range. Footer-only design-concept notice; meta robots noindex. No WhatsApp link (no verified WhatsApp number — order form opens email instead).
image_note: Every photo viewed on contact sheets before use (81 Pexels candidates viewed, 20 kept). Rejected as wrong subject/trade: raw sausages, hot dogs, dachshunds, burger + fries, Starbucks-branded bagel, raw carrots, spilled seeds, pancakes, pizza, samosas, dumplings, macaroni, supermarket aisle, fruit baskets, Turkish-flag bakery window, branded Kumbasar bakery window, factory worker, child blowing candles, churros, doughnuts. No image ID reused from design-log.json (checked programmatically against all logged Pexels IDs) or from today's siblings Dough York / Peculiar Pooches Parlour. Each image served as WebP 1600px + 800px srcset, every file under 250 KB. Gallery carries the note 'Photographs are illustrative of the bakery's range.'
originality_note: Checked against design-log.json: archetype 'Dark luxury minimal' is NOT in the last 10 log archetypes (Bento grid, Full-bleed cinematic, Scrolling story/timeline, Retro poster, Asymmetric photo collage, Split-screen with sticky side, Swiss grid, Bold brutalist type, Playful rounded, Editorial magazine); type pairing 'DM Serif Display + DM Sans' is not used as a pair in the log (DM Serif Display appears only with Outfit and with Inter); no image ID reused; combination differs from every log entry on at least 4 of 6 axes. Pairwise vs today's siblings: Peculiar Pooches Parlour (Playful rounded, Baloo 2 + Nunito, warm white, dog close-up hero, nav Grooming/How it works/Why us/Gallery/Meet Whayde/Visit) and Dough York (Editorial magazine, Cormorant + Jost, warm white, photo-mosaic hero, nav Daily bake/Our story/Order/From the ovens/Visit) — this site differs on archetype, hero (full-screen oven photo), fonts, colour (dark espresso vs warm white), section order (marquee second, counter board before story, signature bakes before gallery, catering & deli section, visit before FAQ) and all image IDs.
